payload.reason: The evidence specifies the use of Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) as part of the ensemble of RNN classifiers employed in the study.

claims.text: The classifiers used in the study include Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) as part of an ensemble of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) classifiers.
The study experimented with various setups of LSTM models enhanced with novel features in an ensemble.
The output layer of the classifiers consists of 3 neurons for classifying Neutral, Racism, and Sexism.
